issue.title: Repair test suite after artifact pane changes
issue.description: During required verification for an unrelated Logs pane module split, just test produced 308 failures (24945 passed, 7 skipped). The failures reproduce in isolation and predate the refactor: tests still expect key 5 to select the PRs artifact subtab, but the app now remains on Files, and onboarding tests expect the old Commits/Plans/Chats/Bugs/PRs/Files ordering while the implementation includes Beads. Most PNG visual failures cascade from the stale artifact-subtab setup. Update affected behavior tests/helpers/goldens for the current artifact pane layout, then run just test.
